sources.prompt:
Japanese anime-style chibi mobile-game environment art, like the tile set of a cosy slice-of-life anime puzzle game. Drawn by hand by a professional 2D anime game background artist: flat cel colours with one crisp hard-edged shadow tone, thick dark-brown outline (#4A2A1A) with slight natural line-weight variation (thicker on outer silhouettes, thinner on inner details), one small flat white highlight per shiny surface, chunky rounded chibi shapes (buildings, trees, rocks and props squashed and rounded like cute toys), limited warm Japanese palette, light from the top-left. Few, deliberate details, every shape clearly readable at 64 pixels. Avoid the typical AI-art look: no airbrushed or soft gradient shading, no plastic or 3D-render sheen, no photographic texture, no texture noise, no random extra sparkles or particles, no melted or merged details, no blurry edges. No characters or people unless asked, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark. Outline weight matches a cartoon salmon-nigiri game icon.

Setting: the Fukuoka Night Stall region of the map, Fukuoka at night: rows of yatai food stalls with red lanterns along a river, steam rising from ramen pots, an indigo sky. Region colours: banner #5B5FC7 to #353A8C, land #C9B27E.

Tile sheet: 2x2 grid of 4 equal 512x512 cells, one item per cell, no borders, no grid lines, no gutters, no labels, no numbers. Straight top-down view, flat, no perspective. Every item at the same scale with the same outline weight. Ground tiles fill their cell edge to edge, opaque, with no outline or border round the cell; the left edge matches the right edge and the top edge matches the bottom edge so each repeats seamlessly.

Land:
f1 (top-left) land_a: warm stone pavement in big rounded slabs in #C9B27E.
f2 (top-right) land_b: the same ground about 12% lighter, details in other places, so it alternates with land_a.
f3 (bottom-left) land_c: land_a with a puddle reflecting a red lantern.
f4 (bottom-right) land_d: land_b with a puddle reflecting a red lantern.
Use case: stylized-concept. Output square 1024x1024 opaque PNG, four exact equal logical quadrants with no drawn separators or gutters. Straight top-down 2D ground, NO perspective. Warm stone pavement #C9B27E in left column, about 12% lighter sandy stone #D8C597 in right column. A few very large rounded flat slab shapes, low-contrast thin dark-tan joints and one restrained crisp hard shadow tone. Keep all joints and details at least 8% away from each quadrant boundary, leaving a plain flat solid border so each cell repeats seamlessly. In each lower cell add ONE small irregular puddle with an upside-down red paper lantern reflection, visibly contained inside the puddle, not a physical lantern standing on the pavement. Keep the puddle small, well inside the quadrant, different placement in each cell. No actual lanterns, buildings, trees, river, plants or scenic props. No gradients, texture noise, photographic shading, border outlines, edge shadows or 3D paving.

edits.prompt: Edit the Fukuoka ground atlas for seamless game tiling. Keep its exact 2x2 quadrant layout and keep one lantern-reflection puddle in each lower quadrant. Simplify the pavement radically: each cell should show 3-4 big rounded slab shapes, each completely INSIDE its quadrant, with a sparse flat tan area around them. Use uniform flat solid colors; remove ALL mottling, texture, gradients, shading haze, specks, highlights and small stones. Thin low-contrast tan slab outlines, flat cel fills only. Most crucially, every cell needs a plain uninterrupted border about 40 pixels wide at all four sides; no slab line, puddle or other mark may touch that border. The whole border is uniform #C9B27E in left-column cells and uniform #D8C597 in right-column cells. No outlined cell borders or drawn separators. This ensures opposite edges tile cleanly. Retain the two lower puddles as small clean slate-blue shapes with clear flat red lantern reflections. Opaque square 1024x1024 PNG.

edits.prompt: Edit this transparent Fukuoka 2x2 game-prop atlas. Fix only layout and spacing: SHRINK EACH complete prop to 75% of its current size and recenter it in its own exact equal quadrant. Each prop needs a generous continuous transparent border around it, at least 15% of quadrant width on every side. In particular restore the complete rounded hill silhouette and full tree silhouettes, without any cutoff or straight cropped edge, and make a clear transparent gap between hill and forest. Actual fully transparent alpha background everywhere between props and in openings. Square 1024x1024 PNG.
